sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Dear Rita,

We would like to invite you to celebrate Julie's 14th birthday. This is your ticket to a magical birthday party! To give her a surprise, please join us without telling her about the party.

We also hope that:
* you dress up in Disney style;
* you shout "Surprise!" when Julie comes down the stairs.

We plan to play board games, watch movies and enjoy plenty of snacks. You are also welcome to bring a friend.

Come on down to Julie's house on Park Lane and have some fun!
Saturday, March 12, 2026
From 6:00-9:00 p.m..
Please reply(回复)by March 9, 2026.
RSVP: birthdayparty@geemail.com

questions.prompt: 1. What can we learn about this birthday party?
options: Rita will be the host of it.
Anyone can buy a ticket to join.
It is for Julie who will turn 14 this year.
There will be a magic show.
questions.translation: 关于这个生日派对我们可以了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一句“We would like to invite you to celebrate Julie's 14th birthday.”可知这是为今年满14岁的Julie举办的。故选 It is for Julie who will turn 14 this year.。

questions.prompt: 2. What do the guests plan to shout to the birthday girl?
questions.translation: 客人打算对寿星女孩喊什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章“you shout "Surprise!" when Julie comes down the stairs.”可知喊的是Surprise!。故选 "Surprise!"。

questions.prompt:
3. What will people do at the party?
a. Play board games.
b. Watch movies.
c. Dress up their dolls.
d. Eat snacks.
questions.translation: 人们在派对上会做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据“We plan to play board games, watch movies and enjoy plenty of snacks.”可知包含a、b、d三项。故选 abd。

questions.prompt: 4. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: The party will last about three hours.
Guests will go to a Disney park.
Guests must reply to the invitation by March 6.
questions.translation: 下列哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据“From 6:00-9:00 p.m..”可知派对持续3个小时（6点到9点）。故选 The party will last about three hours.。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
We all know that many people like to go to a cafe and drink some coffee or tea there. They can talk with other people and listen to some music when they are drinking coffee. However, "silent cafes" are very popular in Tokyo, Japan these days.

A young woman sits alone in a cafe. She is drinking tea and reading a book. After a while, she writes some words on the notebook and then she gives it to the cafe worker. It says, "Where is the toilet, please?"

We can see many "silent cafes" in Tokyo. They look the same as the common(普通的) cafes. But people in "silent cafes" don't speak to others. They communicate(交流) with each other by writing words on the notebook.

The "silent cafes" are very popular in Tokyo, because some people there are under too much pressure(压力) of work, and they need a place to relax. They want to stay alone for some time, so they like to go to the "silent cafes".

questions.prompt: 5. Where can we see "silent cafes" according to the passage?
questions.translation: 根据文章，我们在哪里可以看到“无声咖啡馆”？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段最后“However, 'silent cafes' are very popular in Tokyo, Japan these days.”可知在日本东京。故选 In Tokyo.。

questions.prompt: 6. The underlined word "it" refers to ________ in the passage.
questions.translation: 文章中画线词“it”指代的是笔记本。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“she writes some words on the notebook and then she gives it to the cafe worker.”可知it指代前面的notebook。故选 the notebook。

questions.prompt: 7. How do people in "silent cafe" communicate with each other?
options: By writing words on a notebook.
questions.translation: 无声咖啡馆里的人们如何相互交流？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“They communicate with each other by writing words on the notebook.”可知是通过在笔记本上写字。故选 By writing words on a notebook.。

questions.prompt: 8. Why do people like "silent cafes"?
options: Because the coffee there is very cheap.
Because the "silent cafes" are very clean.
Because they can get many notebooks there.
Because they can stay alone and relax there.
questions.translation: 为什么人们喜欢“无声咖啡馆”？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“...they need a place to relax. They want to stay alone for some time...”可知是因为可以独处并放松。故选 Because they can stay alone and relax there.。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Not everybody in Britain has a garden, but most houses in Britain do. If you don't have one, you can grow house plants, perhaps by the window or in the bathroom. Bill Jones loves his garden, just as most other Britons do.

Jones retired(退休) five years ago. Now you'll find him collecting the fallen leaves on cold afternoons in autumn and winter, getting everything ready in spring and cutting the grass in summer. He is 70, but gardens are not only for elderly people. Jones' grandson, who is 10, often likes to help him.

Jones lives in a village. Last year, the village won a competition (比赛) for the most beautiful gardens in the United Kingdom. Jones grows beautiful red roses. But he also grows vegetables. And there are sometimes competitions for these too. Jones wants to win a prize for growing the biggest carrot.

questions.prompt: 9. Jones left his job at the age of ________
questions.translation: 琼斯在65岁时退休了。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Jones retired five years ago... He is 70...”可知，70 - 5 = 65岁。故选 65。

questions.prompt: 10. What does Jones usually do in his garden during the summer?
options: He plays games with his grandson.
questions.translation: 夏天琼斯通常在花园里做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“...and cutting the grass in summer.”可知是在夏天割草。故选 He cuts the grass.。

questions.prompt: 11. What do we know about Jones from the last paragraph?
options: He lives in the most beautiful garden in the UK.
He won a prize for the most beautiful red roses.
He holds a competition for growing vegetables.
He wants to grow the biggest carrot to win a prize.
questions.translation: 从最后一段中我们可以了解到关于琼斯的什么信息？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段末尾“Jones wants to win a prize for growing the biggest carrot.”可知他想种植最大的胡萝卜来获奖。故选 He wants to grow the biggest carrot to win a prize.。

questions.prompt: 12. With Jones' story, the writer tries to tell us ________
options: who the greatest gardener in the UK is
most British people enjoy taking care of their gardens
there are many kinds of competitions in the UK
what Jones does to get ready for a competition
questions.translation: 通过琼斯的故事，作者试图告诉我们大多数英国人喜欢照料他们的花园。
questions.explanation: 文章通过Jones的事例印证了第一段“Bill Jones loves his garden, just as most other Britons do.”。故选 most British people enjoy taking care of their gardens。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 第二节
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
The lights go out and the candles on the cake are lit (点燃). It's your birthday! [13] But before that, friends and family will sing you a song. Do you know which one? [14] Every English speaker learns this song at a very young age. It is the most recognized(普遍接受的)song in the English language, according to the Guinness World Records!

It is thought that American sisters Patty and Mildred Hill wrote the song as a classroom greeting in the US. [15] Yet the words were very different. Instead of (用……代替) "Happy birthday to you", the words were "Good morning to all".

The two sisters, both teachers, made the song so children could easily sing it to one another. [16]

Today, the song is popular across the English-speaking world, from the US and Canada, to the UK and Australia.
wordbank: A. When a student had a birthday, the class would sing to them.
B. It's time to make a wish and blow out (吹灭) the candles.
C. It was released (发行) in 1893.
D. It's Happy Birthday to You!
E. People still sing this song today.

questions.translation: 到了许愿并吹灭蜡烛的时候了。
questions.explanation: 承接前句点燃蛋糕蜡烛的情景，说明该吹蜡烛许愿了。故选 B项 (It's time to make a wish and blow out (吹灭) the candles.)。

questions.translation: 它就是《祝你生日快乐》！
questions.explanation: 回答前句的问句“Do you know which one?”，引出歌曲名字。故选 D项 (It's Happy Birthday to You!)。

questions.translation: 它于1893年发行。
questions.explanation: 承接前句歌曲创作的历史背景，交代其发行年份。故选 C项 (It was released (发行) in 1893.)。

questions.translation: 当有学生过生日时，全班就会为他们唱这首歌。
questions.explanation: 交代两位教师创作此曲在课堂生日情境下的应用。故选 A项 (When a student had a birthday, the class would sing to them.)。

sections.title: 五、完形填空
sections.instruction: 二、完形填空 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
On hot summer days, nothing can cool you off better than cold drinks. Chinese and Americans both have [17] favourite summer drinks.

Sour plum drink (酸梅汤) may be the most popular summer [18] in China. The sour plum [19] usually made into powder(粉末) or jam(果酱). Then, you just need to [20] it into water. The drink is sweet and sour (酸的).

Chinese people also [21] mung bean soup(绿豆汤) and chrysanthemum tea(菊花茶) in the summertime.

[22] the US, many people like having a [23] of lemonade (柠檬水) during the summer. They put lemon juice, sugar, water and ice into a cup. It's [24] to make. Sometimes, people also put other [25] into it, like mango and watermelon. But other people like a thicker(更浓郁的)drink. [26] may have a milkshake(奶昔).

questions.translation: 中国人与美国人都有他们最喜欢的夏日饮品。
questions.explanation: 主语为复数的Chinese and Americans，物主代词用their。故选 their。

questions.translation: 酸梅汤可能是中国最受欢迎的夏日饮品。
questions.explanation: 酸梅汤属于饮品（drink）。故选 drink。

questions.translation: 酸梅通常被制成粉末或果酱。
questions.explanation: 主语The sour plum为单数名词，be动词一般现在时用is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 然后，你只需要把它放入水中。
questions.explanation: put sth. into water 表示把某物放入水中冲泡。故选 put。

questions.translation: 中国人在夏天也喜欢绿豆汤和菊花茶。
questions.explanation: 表达喜爱某种饮品用动词like。故选 like。

questions.translation: 在美国……
questions.explanation: 在国家前用介词In，句首大写。故选 In。

questions.translation: ……喜欢喝一杯柠檬水。
questions.explanation: lemonade为液体饮品，一杯柠檬水用a glass of lemonade。故选 glass。

questions.translation: 它制作起来很容易。
questions.explanation: 根据上文只需混合几种原料，说明制作方法简单（easy to make）。故选 easy。

questions.translation: ……放入其他水果，比如芒果和西瓜。
questions.explanation: mango and watermelon 属于水果（fruits）。故选 fruits。

questions.translation: 他们可能会喝一杯奶昔。
questions.explanation: 指代前句复数的other people，主格代词用They。故选 They。

sections.title: 六、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 三、语篇填空 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage:
Do you have [27] doll? Does she have many beautiful clothes? Who makes her clothes? Kim Culmone from the US is a fashion designer. But unlike other designers, she only [28] (make) clothes for dolls.

Culmone is 43 [29] (year) old. She [30] (work) at a doll company in the US. Her job is to design and make new clothes [31] doll. Culmone likes [32] (watch) fashion shows on the streets. When she sees eye-catching(抢眼的)clothes, she gets some ideas for her designs.

Culmone is more [33] (interesting) in the world of doll's clothes. Every day, she spends most of her time drawing different [34] (kind) of dresses for doll, and makes them into [35] (really) clothes.

"I love dolls very much, and when I was young, I dreamed of making clothes for my own dolls," Culmone says.

It's not a piece [36] cake!

questions.prompt: 27. Do you have ______ doll?
questions.translation: 你有一个洋娃娃吗？
questions.explanation: 泛指一个洋娃娃，doll以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。故选 a。

questions.prompt: 28. ...she only ______ (make) clothes for dolls.
questions.translation: ……她只为娃娃制作衣服。
questions.explanation: 主语she为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词加-s为makes。故选 makes。

questions.prompt: 29. Culmone is 43 ______ (year) old.
questions.translation: 卡尔莫内43岁了。
questions.explanation: 43后接复数名词years（...years old）。故选 years。

questions.prompt: 30. She ______ (work) at a doll company...
questions.translation: 她在一家玩具公司工作……
questions.explanation: 主语She为第三人称单数，谓语动词用works。故选 works。

questions.prompt: 31. ...make new clothes ______ doll.
questions.translation: ……为娃娃设计制作新衣服。
questions.explanation: make sth. for... 表示“为……制作某物”。故选 for。

questions.prompt: 32. Culmone likes ______ (watch) fashion shows...
questions.translation: 卡尔莫内喜欢在街上看时装秀……
questions.explanation: like doing sth. 表示习惯性喜欢做某事，用watching。故选 watching。

questions.prompt: 33. Culmone is more ______ (interesting) in...
questions.translation: 卡尔莫内对洋娃娃衣服的世界更感兴趣。
questions.explanation: be interested in 为固定短语，修饰人对某事感兴趣。故选 interested。

questions.prompt: 34. ...different ______ (kind) of dresses...
questions.translation: ……不同种类的裙子……
questions.explanation: different kinds of 表示“不同种类的”。故选 kinds。

questions.prompt: 35. ...makes them into ______ (really) clothes.
questions.translation: ……并将它们制作成真正的衣服。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词clothes用形容词real（真实的）。故选 real。

questions.prompt: 36. It's not a piece ______ cake!
questions.translation: 这可不是一件轻而易举的事！
questions.explanation: a piece of cake 为常用习语，意为“小菜一碟/轻而易举的事”。故选 of。

sections.title: 七、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
Have you ever wondered why we say *maidongxi*(买东西) instead of *mainanbei*(买南北), and *yijianxiangzuo*(意见相左) instead of *yijianxiangyou*(意见相右)? Many Chinese words have directions in them, and there is lots of history and culture hidden behind.

When going shopping, Chinese people say *maidongxi*, instead of *mainanbei*. One theory (说法) says that in the Tang Dynasty, there were two popular markets in Chang'an, the national capital at the time. One was called the East Market, and the other was called the West Market. When shopping, people usually went to the East Market first, and then went to the West Market. As time went by, people started to describe shopping as *maidongxi*.

In Chinese, we say *yijianxiangzuo* when we have different opinions. Why is it not *yijianxiangyou*? Most people today are right-handed. They feel uncomfortable if they try to use their left hand to write or use chopsticks. This was true in old times as well. So in ancient Chinese, "left" was related to being different, such as in *yijianxiangzuo*. If people don't accept common beliefs, we still say they are following *pangmenzuodao*(旁门左道). "Left" and "right" also have something to do with people's social status(地位). For a long time in ancient China, "right" stood for higher status than "left".

questions.prompt: 37. How many markets were there in Chang'an in the Tang Dynasty?
questions.translation: 唐代长安城有多少个著名的市场？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“there were two popular markets in Chang'an... One was called the East Market, and the other was called the West Market.”可知是2个。故选 2./Two.。

questions.prompt: 38. When do Chinese say *yijianxiangzuo*?
options: When they go shopping in the market.
When they use right hands to write.
questions.translation: 中国人什么时候说“意见相左”？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“In Chinese, we say yijianxiangzuo when we have different opinions.”可知是当产生不同观点时。故选 When they have different opinions.。

questions.prompt: 39. How do most people feel if they use their left hand to write or use chopsticks?
questions.translation: 如果大多数人用左手写字或使用筷子，他们会感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“They feel uncomfortable if they try to use their left hand to write or use chopsticks.”可知感到不习惯/不舒服（Uncomfortable）。故选 Uncomfortable.。

questions.prompt: 40. What do you usually buy when you go shopping? Why? (30 words or more)
options: When I go shopping, I usually buy books, stationery and delicious snacks. Reading books broadens my knowledge, while nice notebooks make my school study neat. I also share snacks with my good friends.
I never go shopping because I don't need anything in my life.
I only buy toys and never study at school.
Shopping is very boring for all middle school students.
questions.translation: 你去购物时通常买什么？为什么？（30词或更多）
questions.explanation: 选项A陈述了购买书籍、文具和零食的清单及理由，句意流畅，符合题意与字数要求。故选A。
